row_fields: All fields in ../role_contract_review/record_schema_proposal_v1.json plus panel, canvas_id, roster_class, primary_proposition_domain and scope_justification

source_reference_fields.file: repository-relative path to a frozen source
source_reference_fields.original_field_value: exact unmodified value at pointer (string/list/object allowed)
source_reference_fields.interpretive_use: Plain-language explanation of the specific assertion this field supports; no metadata-as-answer

field_boundary_basis: List of objects {description, source_ref_indices}; references index this row source_refs. A field-boundary fact may support a broad scene role without a unique object.
scope_justification: Per-row explanation of why facts concern the whole observed writing group, only a subset, context, or unknown; do not equate rectangle enclosure with attention.
retained_original_fields: ID, original box, band, original candidate list must equal frozen sources. Include all subgroup alternatives in full_block_grouping_notes or cite their exact source field, never silently pick one.
